profile.company_description: Handy Helperly is one point of contact for home services. We coordinate repairs, property preparation, cleaning, junk removal, packing, moving, storage, and new-home setup for homeowners and Realtors before, during, and after a move. We also take on single home-service projects, from one repair to a few rooms of painting. Serving Greater St. Louis and St. Charles County. Call (636) 459-1530 or request service at handyhelperly.com.
profile.ig_bio:
One contact for home services before, during & after a move, or one project.
Repairs · Cleaning · Junk removal · Packing
St. Louis & St. Charles Co.
